items.markdown:
![Necklace Size Chart: A Complete Guide to Fit, Style & Comfort](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10031145-2330-0066-0000-c1a19e6b42c1:16)
Standard necklace lengths range from `12 inches for a tight collar up to 37+ inches for a long rope chain` , with 18 inches being the most common length for women.[[1]](https://mirojewelers.com/blogs/our-blogs/necklace-length-chart)[[2]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/necklace-length-chart/)[[3]](https://objktsjewelry.com/pages/necklace-size-chart)

### Standard Necklace Length Chart

| Style Name | Length in Inches | Length in Centimeters | Where It Falls on the Body |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Collar** | 12"–13" | 30–33 cm | Tightly around the middle of the neck |
| **Choker** | 14"–16" | 35–41 cm | Base of the neck or throat |
| **Princess** | 17"–19" | 43–48 cm | At or just below the collarbone (most common) |
| **Matinee** | 20"–24" | 51–61 cm | Resting above or at the top of the bust |
| **Opera** | 28"–36" | 71–91 cm | Below the bust or mid-chest |
| **Rope / Lariat** | 37"+ | 94 cm+ | Below the sternum (can be doubled) |

You can find more visual aids on [Tiffany & Co.](https://www.tiffany.com/client-services/size-guide/necklaces-pendants-size.html) or read a detailed breakdown on [Miro Jewelers](https://mirojewelers.com/blogs/our-blogs/necklace-length-chart).[[1]](https://mirojewelers.com/blogs/our-blogs/necklace-length-chart)[[2]](https://www.tiffany.com/client-services/size-guide/necklaces-pendants-size.html)

### How to Measure Your Neck Size

- Wrap a soft measuring tape around your neck where you want the necklace to rest.
- Add 2 to 4 inches to your actual neck measurement to find a comfortable choker or short chain length.
- Leave at least a 2-inch gap between different chains if you plan on layering them.[[1]](https://us.pandora.net/en/guide-size-necklaces/guide-size-necklaces.html)[[2]](https://www.pinterest.com/pin/how-to-choose-the-right-necklace-length-video-in-2024--91127592458752567/)

If you'd like, tell me:

- Are you shopping for a **men's or women's** necklace?
- Do you plan to add a **pendant**?

I can help you pick the best length for your style.
